UGA.note: Mentions consumer protection only in regard to unlicensed Wi-Fi resellers; no digital financial services rule.
MYUG sites are in Kampala, Wakiso and Entebbe and dated 2016-2022; no rural programme or rural/urban survey figures.
NITA-U's MYUG Wi-Fi is described as 2016-2022 history; no 2023-or-later statement of staff running a system.

facts.fact: UCC met the Kampala City Traders Association and Wi-Fi hotspot operators on 20 October 2026 and announced a multi-stakeholder committee on licensing for resellers.
